title: pelea clusiifolia var. cookeana
intro: Pelea clusiifolia var. cookeana, commonly known as the 'Ma'o hau hele,' is a plant species native to Hawaii, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and medicinal properties. The Ma'o hau hele is valued for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate skin conditions and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm inflammation, reduce pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Pelea clusiifolia var. cookeana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
